items.name: Whole salad kit, including all dressing and toppings
items.note: Usual whole kit reused from saved actual label, including all kit dressing and toppings. Additional Litehouse dressing recorded separately. About 3 servings; label-derived grams, not weighed.

items.name: Black olives, half regular 12-serving can
items.note: Explicit assumption: normal can means the regular approximately 12-serving can from prior label, not the smaller 4-serving can. Half can is 6 servings of 2 tbsp (16 g): 90 kcal and 750 mg sodium. Label-derived grams, not weighed. Fiber, sugars, vitamin D, calcium and potassium are not quantified on this label and remain unknown.

items.name: Weis sweet peas, half can
items.note: Actual user label inspected natively: about 3.5 servings per can, 1/2 cup (125 g) per serving. Half can is 1.75 servings. Sodium is 15 mg per serving, not a generic canned-pea estimate. Approximate can serving count and label-derived grams; no external image upload.

items.name: Litehouse blue cheese dressing, additional 2 tbsp (30 mL)
items.source: Actual user label inspected natively; per 2 tbsp (30 mL): 150 kcal, fat 16 g, carbs 1 g, protein 1 g. Added sugars less than 1 g per serving; not exact zero.
items.note: Two additional tablespoons beyond included kit dressing, using actual saved Litehouse label, not Bolthouse. Added sugars less than 1 g per serving; unknown exact value retained.

items.name: Cooked farfalle with meat sauce and shredded Parmesan, one plate
items.note: Photo-estimated single plate shown before and after toppings (not multiple servings): 2.5 cups COOKED farfalle, 3/4 cup meat sauce, 1/3 cup shredded Parmesan. Portion size and recipe uncertain; no extra oil or drinks assumed. Component estimates: pasta 422.65 kcal, 15.515 g protein, 82.550 g carbs, 2.488 g fat; sauce 175.50 kcal, 11.583 g protein, 12.753 g carbs, 8.502 g fat; Parmesan 146.667 kcal, 13.333 g protein, 1.333 g carbs, 9.333 g fat.
items.source: USDA FDC 169737 cooked enriched pasta: 107 g per cup farfalle, 158 kcal/100 g (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/169737/nutrients). USDA FDC 2706470 spaghetti sauce with meat: 260 g/cup, 90 kcal/100 g (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/2706470/nutrients), generic recipe proxy. Sargento shredded Parmesan label: 1/4 cup (28 g), 110 kcal, 10 g protein, 1 g carbs, 7 g fat (https://www.sargento.com/our-cheese/shredded-cheese/sargento-shredded-parmesan-natural-cheese/), brand proxy only.
